Enoch signifies the exhaled Breath, the Power and the Word of Divine Delight; and because all the wonders of the world are arranged into seven times <note>In Böhmean theology, world history is divided into seven spiritual epochs or "times," mirroring the seven days of creation and the seven spirits of God.</note>, he is the beginning of the seventh and last time. Among the other six times, he indicates the secret wonders of God and what was to happen; he leads his way through the coverings of Noah, Abraham, and Moses, until he reaches the Kingdom of Christ. There, that same Prophetic Spirit is raptured into the Spirit of Christ until the end of the sixth time. Thus he reveals himself in the number of the triple cross: When the triple cross reveals itself, then the true triple crown stands upon the cross. At that time, the Enochian Prophetic-Mouth speaks forth the great wonders of the triple cross—that is, he no longer speaks magically <note>To speak "magically" in this context refers to the internal, hidden, or symbolic language of the spirit. Dreyfaltigkeit"</note> in the figure, as the formed Word of God in all visible things, and reveals all mysteries, both internal and external. Then the <term>Turba</term> <note>A term used by Jacob Böhme to describe the "spirit of disturbance" or the wrathful fire of God that breaks forth to destroy vanity and purify the creation before the end.</note> is born, which, when it ignites its fire, shall sweep the threshing floor; for it is the end of all times.

**As** friends, you who truly walk in the **love** of the **God** of **love**—a love that extends to all **humanity**—I do not doubt that the **subject matter** of this **small treatise** will be dear and pleasant to you. For it is a **proclamation** of good and joyful **tidings** from above, intended for all **creatures** who have ever existed since the **beginning** of **time** and who shall exist until its ultimate **goal** and **end**; since **God's** free **grace** desires to extend and reach even that far. <note>This reflects the doctrine of Universal Restoration (Apokatastasis), the belief that all of God's creation will eventually be reconciled to Him.</note>

2. For it must go much deeper, so as to give birth again to a newly created **divine** or **God-like image** in the **soul**, or to restore that which was so wretched, mutilated, corrupted, and faded; and thus, after it has first been conceived through the **birth** of the **Holy Spirit**, [it must be restored] inwardly in each and every

### The Final Purpose of this Small Treatise.

...parts of the soul, causing them to rise up and grow toward a complete renewal.

3. And you will find this to be the entire final purpose, intention, and meaning of the small treatise following here: for after **God** through His Spirit had taught me this great mystery of internal redemption and let me come to know it, I found myself [in my soul] obligated and compelled to bring this to light before my departure (especially since I am already well advanced in years and have already passed the 70th year of my age), so that this treasure might not die with me. For I can perceive it no other way than that it might be my final farewell to this world; therefore, as long as the rising [of the Dayspring] <note>original: "Morgenröthe" — literally "Morning Redness" or "Dawn." Initially—or in the first part—I shall report something by way of an introduction concerning the **Spring-Flower of the Mind** <note>In the mystical tradition of Jacob Böhme, the "Spring-Flower" represents the first blossoming of the divine life within the human soul, signaling the "New Birth."</note>, which, according to its essence <note>original: "Essenz"</note> and nature, stands upon a never-fading root. Within this mind, one will perceive, as in a mirror, the royal grace and spiritual steps—or how one must ascend from one degree to another—together with the great, solemn, and joyful reception and welcome which is accustomed to take place in a spirit thus prepared. This may serve to incite both the heavenly-born spirits and those who are still un-reborn at this time to follow after, so that they all work toward that end and do their utmost (so to speak), so that they may be found in such a heavenly form of their mind.

## The Angels our Traveling Companions.

For if you can but once disentangle and free yourselves from these lower, toilsome, and burdensome **sandy paths** <note>A metaphor for the difficult, dry, and material world that weighs down the soul, contrasting with the "pleasant ways" of the spirit.</note>, you may well enter into these high and **pleasant ways** with **God**; and, once you have entered therein, you will find such manifold **sweetnesses** and **delights** within as will unfailingly entice and oblige you to remain in them, because you will encounter a most agreeable company there. For though there be but few of these among mortal **men**, yet there will be all the more of the **heavenly company** who walk with **you**, and who will converse with you from those upper **regions** toward which you are currently traveling on your **journey**. # Harbingers of the Appearance of Christ's Kingdom.

<header>The Propagation of the Gospel of Eternal Love.</header>

...through <note>Picking up from the previous page: "...namely through [the knowledge of]..."</note> what greatness or extent of redeeming love you will find this little treatise to treat, as a **truth** which has been made known to me through **divine revelation**, and which I have not wished to hide from the world. For as concerns the passages of Scripture that might perhaps be cited against this, they have been explained to me in such a way—and opened up in this manner—that they are more for, rather than against, this point: that just as the **Lord Christ** went and preached to the spirits in prison who were disobedient in the days of **Noah** [or before and after] and were consequently held in bonds in the lower **regions** <note>Refers to the "Harrowing of Hell," the belief that Christ descended into the underworld to rescue souls between his death and resurrection.</note>, yet found salvation at His appearance; (for for what other end would He otherwise have preached the **Gospel** to them, as may be seen in 1 Peter 3:19?) even so it will happen again at His second and final appearance, when He shall come to judge the living and the dead: where He will pronounce a judgment upon the righteous and the unrighteous, upon each according to their works. However, this Judge wishes to reserve the freedom to release and forgive all those who have passed through the **fiery purifications** <note>The "fire" here is viewed as a medicinal or cleansing force rather than purely punitive, intended to humble the soul until it can receive mercy.</note> and have been humbled thereby.

8. ## Divine Revelation made known on May 12/22, 1694.

<image-desc>A large, ornate decorative drop cap letter "E" featuring swirling acanthus-style foliage and floral patterns.</image-desc>

There appeared to me a flower from the paradisical earth, whose nature and quality is eternally unfading and imperishable; for it draws its origin from that very height which the **LORD**, the life-giving Spirit, is from eternity itself.

This, then, is the plant which has grown and shot up of its own accord, although it is quite distinct from the outer nature within me: it is very easily recognized by its graceful and lovely scent, especially since it gives off such a powerful, and such an exceedingly sweet and mild scent of love, that it elevates the soul [in its seven forms <note>A reference to the "seven properties of eternal nature," a core concept in the mysticism of Jacob Boehme and Jane Leade, representing the stages of spiritual manifestation.</note>] in harmony, or lovely unity of will, to such a high degree that the soul no longer feels or perceives any other life within itself but a spiritual divinity. 31. Thus, my highest plea reaches out to You: that Your Spirit, who flows out from You directly from the **Father** and the **Fountain of Wisdom**, would be my constant overseer, guide, and teacher; then I shall not be able to wander from the Truth.

# 46 For the sake of this path, to deny everything.

...and so desire to be sealed? In truth, it is well worth the effort that one leaves and denies everything—whatever things concerning this transitory life might hinder us, block our way, turn us aside, or prevent us from holding intimate *correspondence* <note>original: "Correspondenz" — here meaning spiritual communication or communion with the divine realm.</note> with the Lord and the citizens of this heavenly land. However, how to keep the way open to these great *privileges* <note>original: "Privilegien"</note> has already been described for you by a female traveler experienced in this matter <note>The "experienced female traveler" (Wandersmännin) likely refers to Jane Leade, the English mystic whose works were central to the Philadelphian movement.</note>.

87. The only motivating reason that still remains is this: that by putting on this garment of the Spirit, one may be equipped and provided with some of those gifts and powers formerly imparted to the ancients—those which went forth from the Lord *Christ* and the *Apostles* in their day. These shall undoubtedly reappear and reveal themselves anew as forerunners, signaling that the **Kingdom of Christ on earth in His saints is truly approaching in power**. Indeed, even mightier and greater wonder-working powers (which shall serve as a prelude) are to be revealed in this current age of time.

88. The great day of the coming and appearance of *Christ* in the world draws near; to that end, such deep and inwardly hidden things are being revealed beforehand to prepare for Him a betrothed Bride <note>The "Bride" refers to the Church or the collective body of believers, a common metaphor in mystical theology based on the Book of Revelation.</note> who may be found entirely beautiful, pure, and without any blemish. For *Christ* must have such a church prepared if she is to receive Him on this earth and also have *correspondence* and communion with Him. However, I have dealt with this at length in my other published *little treatise* <note>original: "Tractätlein" — likely a reference to another specific work by the author.</note>.

### Today's Appearance of the Saints

... [unusual] to be that they visit souls through visible appearance; although it may have happened at certain times—as Moses and Elijah appeared to the Lord Christ—yet since His Ascension, all such modes of appearance have been performed more invisibly and essentially. This occurs through inspiration into the soul in a spiritual manner, and through an inflowing and indwelling in our souls, whereby a lovely affection and communal love toward us is expressed by them. We feel the same in our spirits toward them, so that through this they often draw our **Upper-Angel** <term>Upper-Angel: In this mystical context, the "Seelen-Geist" or the highest part of the human spirit that is capable of transcending the physical body to commune with the divine.</term> [Soul-Spirit] up to themselves, so that he may be with them in heavenly places. 15. If, therefore, a soul here below finds Christ—its Love-Root and true origin—actually within itself as an assurance of its love (first in the Eternal Father, and in the Spirit in Christ the Lord), then it may indeed show reverence and honor to these great **Potentates** <note>original: *Potentaten*; referring to the high-ranking saints and spirits who hold authority in the heavenly court.</note> without making itself guilty of spiritual idolatry. These beings have the power to provide help and support in various ways to us, who may stand in need of their assistance. ## An Appearance Occurring through a Vision or Prophecy, on July 25/15, 1694.

<margin>Note well.</margin>
Suddenly, a round globe of an oval shape was presented to me, which had four circles; and within the first circle was a pure, white mirror of light, in which the **personal Prince and Lord of Glory** <note>A title for Jesus Christ, emphasizing his majestic presence in the spiritual realm.</note> appeared, alongside a countless number of bright, lovely figures. Among these were the Elders, who had obtained victory over this world and had passed away in faith of those things which they now possess and enjoy. The entire circumference of the circle, however, was of a bright, flaming color.

2. Further, and after this, there was a sky-blue circle; in this, only the faces of a very large number of persons were to be seen who are still in their physical forms in this world. Some of these were known to me, but others are unknown; and the motto which stood written upon their foreheads was this: "These are those who stand in expectation and strive to break through into the Principle <term>Principium: A term used in 17th-century mysticism to describe a fundamental realm or state of being—in this case, the spiritual reality of the divine kingdom.</term> of Mount Zion, where Christ the Lord is to be found, together with all those who are redeemed <note>original: "erkaufft," literally "purchased" or "bought," a common biblical term for those saved by Christ's sacrifice.</note> from and of the earth."

## Extract from a Letter of the Author to a Friend / dated London <unclear>14.</unclear> June 1695.

Now, dear friend, as concerns the great expansion or the wealth and abundance of the **Love of God**, described in the <term>Enochian Life: Referring to the biblical patriarch Enoch, who "walked with God" (Genesis 5:24); in this mystical context, it signifies a state of perfected, divine life on Earth where the soul enjoys constant communion with God.</term>, such might well be called into doubt by some; nevertheless, I assure you that it is an infallible truth, which will be brought to light and fulfilled in its own time. Therefore, no one should look askance at this nor murmur; considering that, after the completion of the various **scene-changes of the ages** <note>original: "Schaupiels-Veränderungen der Zeiten" — A theatrical metaphor common in Baroque spirituality, suggesting that history is a series of divine acts or stages leading to a final resolution.</note>, the power of the eternal counsel and purpose of the Father shall and must come to pass, and a full and perfect **redemption of the whole creation** through Christ will follow. He, at the end, shall deliver the kingdom to His Father, so that **God may be all in all** <note>original: "daß GOtt alles in allem sey" — A reference to 1 Corinthians 15:28. This reflects the doctrine of Universal Restoration (Apocatastasis), the belief that all souls and even the fallen world will eventually be reconciled with God.</note>, and be revealed through His entire creation for the **restoration** of everything that was lost, so that nothing of all that has its origin in God may perish. For in truth, I do not have this from some old tradition, but it has been given to me from the **Yes and Amen** <note>original: "Ja und Amen" — A name for Christ used in Revelation 3:14, emphasizing that His promises are certain and final.</note> through an express revelation.

# Extract from the Author's Letter of December 20, Old Style 1695.

As concerns the <term>Universal Restoration: The doctrine of "Apocatastasis," or the belief that all sentient beings—including the fallen—will eventually be reconciled to God.</term> or the general redemption of the angels and the entire creation, I can say nothing more or further, except what has been given to me in this regard through Divine Revelation, when my spirit was admitted to the vision of these centers and worlds—as if God had called me there for that very purpose, that He might let me see and recognize His will and intent regarding this great mystery of perfect redemption. 

Concerning the objection that the fallen angels have no redeemer, such must be understood thus: that the apostate fallen creation, which Christ came to redeem, was (so to speak) so deeply "enfleshed" <note>original: "verfleischt" — A mystical term suggesting that fallen spirits have become so entangled with the material and carnal nature of humanity that the two are bound together.</note> that if humanity is to be fully and perfectly redeemed, these fallen spirits, who have introduced themselves into man and united themselves with him, must also be brought back through him. And because grace is offered to everyone throughout, and yet some willfully and stubbornly despise it and trample it underfoot, such must enter into torment, pain, and punishment, and atone for their folly according to the measure and proportion of what they have worked and committed here in this world. 

However, it is not so that such punishments for finite things committed would be infinite; especially since such could never have been the intent of the justice and goodness of the Deity; for it [is contrary] to the true essence and nature of the 

<meta>catchword: God-</meta>

# Author’s Preface.

When on a certain day a certain person—who for many years had been wonderfully exercised and guided in the ways of God—stood in deep contemplation of the **paradisiacal world**, there appeared to her in the midst of a very bright cloud a **Woman**, of an exceedingly graceful, lovely, and majestic appearance. Her face shone like the sun, and her clothes were like translucent gold; she addressed me with these words: "Behold! ### The Sixth Commandment.

Instead of what was said in the Old Covenant: "you shall not kill," it is now required of you here that you—in a blessed sense <note>The author uses "blessed sense" to clarify that he is not advocating for physical suicide, but for a holy, spiritual self-denial.</note>—become a **self-murderer**, or mortify yourself <term>mortificiren: the spiritual practice of "putting to death" the desires and ego of the fleshly nature</term>, and you should not spare the "beheading" of that life which, in the opposite case—and if you do not do it—would itself cut you off from having your name and your place in the new Jerusalem. 

But should you say that such a beheading has already occurred, and that you could not have known any other way of resurrection into this **Paradisiacal light** and freedom—in which you are now frequently deemed worthy to behold glorified objects or subjects, and hear unspeakable voices and sounds which descend and penetrate into your instrumental faculties <note>The "instrumental faculties" refer to the physical and spiritual senses through which a person perceives the world and the divine.</note> of the senses, thereby teaching and informing you of the mind, will, and pleasure of the Father of this your newborn spirit? 

To this I answer you: while it is true that you are now raised into such a life that can no longer fall prey to death—since there is no condemnation <note>A reference to Romans 8:1: "There is therefore now no condemnation to them which are in Christ Jesus."</note> for those who are risen in **Christ Jesus**—nevertheless, you must also know this: that a mortal sense <note>original: "sterblicher Sinn"</note> still remains within you, which long ago forced its way in and has not left you even until this hour. And just as this [mortal sense] was awakened through the first **Adamic man**; so must it be blotted out again within you through the **second Adam** <note>In mystical theology, the "second Adam" is Christ, who restores what the first Adam lost.</note>, if you intend to reach the point where you [are affected] by no curse...

### The Seventh Commandment.

You shall not break the **marriage-bond** and **covenant** with which you are bound to the **Lord**, who is your husband, and to whom you are betrothed through the eternal **Spirit**. ### Chapter Three.

### Concerning the Resistance that met this ecstatic Spirit after the delivery or handing over of these Laws.

After the handing down and revelation of these Paradisiacal Laws <term>Paradiesische Gesetze: In this context, these are not legalistic rules, but the divine principles of the restored state of humanity, meant to guide the soul back to its original perfection.</term>, I found myself surrounded by a rebellious opposition and spirits who sought to stir up a mutiny within me. They tried to incite everything so that I might contradict this most worthy and precious covenant myself, so that it would find no room in me [through unbelief], nor be established and confirmed, nor manifest its power. They hissed their venom at me, saying that these were unbearable burdens and that no one could achieve the things required therein, nor had anyone ever achieved them. They mocked me, asking what I was imagining, or how I dared to be so presumptuous? In what way did I think my own ability was greater than that of other people, that I should expect and hope for the fulfillment of these things within myself?

They argued that to put my neck under such a yoke, and to clamp my feet into the shackles of these harsh and strict commandments, would be nothing other than entering again into the service of the law <note>The "service of the law" refers to the Old Testament legal system, which mystics believed was superseded by the internal spirit of Christ.</note> and turning the Covenant of Grace <term>Bund der Gnaden: The theological concept that salvation is a gift from God through faith, rather than something earned by following a set of rules (works).</term> back into a matter of "works." ## The Author’s Response to Several Questions Proposed to Her.

Since the doctrine of **Universal Restoration** <note>original: "allgemeinen Erlösung," the belief that all souls will eventually be saved</note> was made known through printing, certain objections and questions have been put to me. First: how can one reconcile the Scripture passage <note>original: "Schrift-Ort"</note> concerning the **eternity of punishment** with this, since they are to be purified from eternity to eternity? To this I answer that various "eternities" are enclosed within the one great Eternity, which is the infinite circumference of the one Element. Accordingly, it must be understood that according to the original language <note>referring to the Greek *aion* or Hebrew *olam*, which can mean an "age" or "epoch" rather than infinite time</note>, these "eternities" are certain ages of time in which they will have to endure their punishments. Furthermore, it is well known that all worlds and eternities will have their goal and end, because they aim at something that is either hard and heavy, or unhappy; but the elementary still eternity will have no end, as it is **GOD** himself, from whom all things have their source and origin, and out of which a new creation is yet to be generated and created.

2. The second point is: whether the **New Birth** <note>original: "Wiedergeburt"</note> can also take place after this life? To which I answer: that those who neglected the new birth [in this life] must be born again somewhere else, because they cannot otherwise ascend to the perfected spirits in the **Kingdom of Mount Zion**. The rebirth that was not completed here must be worked out in other worlds or regions, although it has been shown to me that passing through such will be much harder and more difficult than it might have been here in a certain respect, because they lack the instrumental faculties of the elementary <note>physical or material</note> body; therefore, they must pass through punishment for their evil deeds in suffering and pain, which searches through everything with anguish until they have broken through the **second death**. For just as Christ the Lord went down to preach to the spirits in prison <note>A reference to 1 Peter 3:19</note> who were disobedient in the days of Noah, so Christ likewise has his ministers under him who preach to these spirits in prison, that they might embrace faith in Christ, so that they may be restored and thus advance through purification from one degree to another until they are perfectly saved.

3. The third question is concerning the **fallen angels**, namely, whether there is still some possibility for their recovery? As to what <note>catchword: "Was nun"</note>

# Conversion of the Devils

<meta>catchword: himself</meta>

Now, concerning this matter, I first lay down as a foundation that they did not create themselves, nor did they give themselves a being; rather, their origin or generation was from **GOD**. However, they awakened something within themselves that sought to presume and seize for itself the power of fire and sovereign dominion, as if to be **GOD** himself. This <term>arrogance</term> <note>original: "Ubermuth," implying a rebellious pride or over-reaching one's station</note> drove them out of the heavenly principality. 

Following this, the question is: how can they enter again into love, gentleness, and light?

**Answer:** Just as the Lord **Christ** entered into the rebellious, fallen flesh of humanity so that he might redeem it and change all the evil qualities introduced by the serpent—actually blotting out and healing the sting of sin within humanity—so will he also do the same in his own time for the fallen angels. For they are not entirely without that **spark of eternal love** <note>This "divine spark" is a central concept in German mysticism, suggesting that a part of God remains even in the darkest soul</note> which (although it currently lies dead, and the wrathful spirit holds dominion over it) will nevertheless awaken them to their former state and make them into glorious angels once again. This will be the highest wonder of all wonders, wherein one will marvel at **GOD** more than at any other action of his previous creation. 

However, this cannot be expected or occur until all creatures who have been under their dominion are snatched out of their kingdom, and the fallen angels see that these same creatures—having been purchased and redeemed through **Jesus Christ**—are exalted to their princely thrones and dignities, and all the various worlds are filled. Then, and upon this, a deep anguish, as well as repentance and the gnawing of conscience, shall begin to work within the fallen angels from the spark of the Godhead that could not be extinguished in them. Thus, in the conclusion and final transformation of all the marvelous wonders of God, everything that is of a wrathful and evil quality shall be consumed by the fire, and an end shall be made to all evil. Sin, misery, death, and hell must be swallowed up in that same <term>pool</term> <note>original: "Pfuhle," likely referring to the "lake of fire" mentioned in Revelation, interpreted here as a place of transformative purification</note> wherein they shall never again be awakened; for they shall be sealed with the bond of God’s love, which shall never again be broken. 

For just as God in the beginning was alone goodness and joy, life and blessedness, so shall everything be turned back and restored to that very same infinite happiness. For **GOD** would never be at peace with himself, nor have a sufficient pleasure in himself, if the devils and death, torment and misery, were to have no end, but were to be eternal just like **GOD** himself. But it is determined and destined far otherwise, according to the many reports and assurances I have received in the manner of a revelation from **GOD** himself...

Accordingly, I conclude with all earnest pleading that the true understanding of heavenly mysteries may be given in a more general way to all those who wait for true and right instruction, and that they may also refrain from judging and condemning until the day breaks more clearly—which even now is in its dawning—to bring to light that which has never yet been revealed in former times.

move and bring forth—to renew those same beings once again to the beauty they possessed at the beginning. Next, some fiery streams seemed to proceed from this great manifest sea, which had such an attractive power of love that they drew our figurative hearts into themselves so that we walked and lived in these fiery or burning streams, after we had been transformed into bright-flaming bodies; and these streams drew us into the great manifest sea. # Universal Blessedness
<note>original: *Allgemeine Seeligkeit*. This refers to the theological concept of Universalism, the belief that all souls will eventually be reconciled with God.</note>

<meta>catchword: A</meta>

...[this would] not have happened, had I not received a special command for it from my Lord Jesus, which I did not dare to resist. Otherwise, one can consider how, since an everlasting and eternally enduring damnation has been preached for these thousand years, no terror or fear of the Devil has been instilled in anyone by it; instead, those who are godless wish to remain godless, and those who are unjust wish to remain unjust; even though I have warned everyone not to turn grace into wantonness <note>original: *Muthwillen*, referring to intentional sin or taking divine forgiveness for granted.</note>.

4 Regarding that which is said, that those who have sinned against the Holy Spirit shall be forgiven neither in this world nor in the world to come; I answer briefly, that it is something very rare and exalted to recognize who is actually or in truth guilty of this sin; for that reason, it is not so easily recognized or determined that anyone can make themselves guilty of such a sin. However, in the event that they truly commit this sin, Christ’s word may be justified in its sense and interpreted such that there are certain worlds in which **punishment** and **damnation** await them after they have departed from the body. But when they have suffered for a time, and have seen enough cause to turn away from such blasphemy and all other deception (since they have their preachers, namely the high Saints), they may be released from such a world and region and escape. For once and for certain, Christ is the mediator for the entire fallen creation, excluding none: of which he gave them a sufficient testimony or sign when he prayed for his enemies and those who crucified him. For if anyone were guilty of the sin against the Holy Spirit, it would above all be the Jews who crucified, mocked, laughed at, and blasphemed the Spirit of the Godhead that was in him: and yet He (whose prayer has never failed) prayed for them, that it might be forgiven them. Which forgiveness I have ground and cause to believe did not happen in this world, but rather they must suffer for it in the other world, and then, after they have passed through the punishments, such sins will be forgiven them according to Christ's prayer.

# The Publisher to the Reader.

The words: **Blessed are the poor in spirit; for theirs is the kingdom of heaven;** were not placed at the head of the Heavenly Teaching without great cause—that teaching which was delivered to us in Matthew 5 by our blessed Master from the Mount of Beatitudes in the highest majesty and love. If, then, the poor in spirit are blessed, it follows that those who are "rich in spirit" must necessarily be wretched, and consequently, a heavy woe lies upon them; because the kingdom of heaven cannot be theirs. 

However, even though a "poor spirit" must nowadays be a subject of mocking laughter and has become a proverb and a disgrace among those who call themselves Christians and profess to be disciples of Jesus—who was so obviously and more than all the sons of Adam "poor in spirit"—yet the <term>Wisdom of God</term><note>God's wisdom is often contrasted in this era with "carnal" or human reason, which seeks status rather than humility.</note> (which is diametrically opposed to the cleverness of man and accuses it of folly) wishes to have those honored whom man dishonors. Conversely, God dishonors those whom man has honored above all else and in which man has exalted himself in pride. For <term>poverty of spirit</term><note>In this context, "poverty of spirit" refers to a state of total humble dependence on God, stripping away intellectual and social pride.</note>, which is a disgrace, a thing of contempt, and the <term>scum of the world</term><note>original German: "Auskericht," meaning the sweepings or refuse gathered when cleaning a house.</note>, shall—on the day when God gathers His <term>treasures</term><note>original German: "Kleinodien und Juwehlen." This refers to Malachi 3:17, where God describes His faithful followers as His jewels.</note> and jewels—be turned into glory, into a crown, and into a kingdom for all those who have followed the footsteps of their Master in the <term>rebirth</term><note>Spiritual regeneration or "Wiedergeburt," a central theme in Pietist theology involving a radical internal transformation.</note>.

# A Sermon for an Infant Baptism.

Just as circumcision in the Old Testament was performed at eight days of age by virtue of divine decree <note>Referring to the covenant established with Abraham in Genesis 17:12, where infants were brought into the faith community through this rite.</note>, serving as the means of admission into the Church and into God's Covenant of Grace, so now in the New Testament, Holy Baptism has taken its place. It is used as a means of grace <term>Gnaden-Mittel: A theological term for the physical instruments—specifically the Word and the Sacraments—through which God's grace is believed to be conveyed to people.</term> through which we are sanctified and sealed to God as His children. Circumcision was an outward sign performed upon the flesh; Holy Baptism, however, is an inward sign that occurs through water and the Spirit, making us heirs of eternal life. In this holy bath <note>The author uses "bath" as a poetic reference to the "washing of regeneration" mentioned in the New Testament (Titus 3:5).</note>, which we now intend to perform for this child, the corruption of our sinful nature is washed away, and the soul is born anew through the Holy Spirit, so that the child may become a member of Christ, a child of God, and an heir of eternal life—performed in His most highly praised Name: the Father, the Son, and the Holy Spirit. Amen!

# The Tree of Faith.

When I remind myself and consider, at the conclusion of this year 1686, by thinking back on what has occurred from one New Year to the next—both in regard to what I have conquered and attained internally in spiritual matters through diligence, and how I have grown therein and risen from one stage to another; as well as what else has occurred and transpired, through extraordinary **Divine Providence**, in those things that concern the **outward man** <note>The "outward man" refers to the physical, earthly life and circumstances, as opposed to the "inward man" or the soul.</note>; (since for several years now, for my own satisfaction, I have kept a **memorial** <term>memorial: a spiritual diary or record of internal experiences</term> or testimony of both, and have paid close attention to how the **Work of God** has begun and proceeded within me, to bring to perfection that upon which my **soul** has expended such effort and labor for so many years; especially, I say, when I consider that which has been revealed to me through the **Spirit of Prophecy** since the year 1670 in vision and contemplation; so I have found, from that year onwards and so forth until this approaching New Year’s time, that the active wheel <note>original: "wirckende Rad." # Constancy in Faith.

...[promises], even new prophecies and promises have followed hard upon their heels, by means of which the **fountains of faith**—which otherwise might have been stopped up—have been preserved and kept open. Therefore, I must rightly praise the goodness of my God and publicly proclaim: that He has not only preserved the **root of faith** within me, but has also increasingly bestowed more **power for growth**; toward a hopeful preparation and **completion** of all that which is still lacking <note>original: "hinterstellig." This refers to things remaining or left behind, suggesting spiritual tasks or revelations yet to be fulfilled.</note>; especially as these are such great and important things, which are well worth waiting for with earnestness. These things, if I may happily attain them, will sufficiently compensate for all the damage suffered on their account—damage I have had in sensual things <term>sensual things: objects and experiences perceived through the five physical senses, often contrasted with spiritual realities</term>, regarding that which can be called earthly and transitory, which are seen only among mortals, and from all of which I have been powerfully called away at all times: for I have found within myself from year to year that **life and love** for all transitory things have increasingly decreased and diminished. # The Forsaking of Worldly Things.

### The Heavenly Planting.

...that this work, so long set aside—which had its beginning already on the Day of Pentecost—might, after so many years of postponement and delay, gain its progress and one day break forth again. For this I have waited in secret with earnestness and sought with diligence, where I might find some spirits who had a true inclination and desire to wait in the pure temple of their minds, united into one heart and soul, so that the great wedding-pledge <term>wedding-pledge: translating "Mahlschatz," which refers to a betrothal gift or token; here it signifies the spiritual endowment or "earnest" of the Holy Spirit</term> of holy power might rise up again and manifest itself; but until this very day, through an occurring separation and scattering among the holy people, one has been deterred, frightened away, and kept from the other, and indeed mostly for the sake of small, base, and worldly things and causes; so much so that until this hour, no body or community of the saints <note>original: "Gemeine der Heiligen." This refers to the Pietist ideal of the "ecclesiola in ecclesia" or the true, spiritual fellowship of believers distinct from the formal church institution.</note> could yet be brought together, which has pained me greatly and caused a secret suffering and anxiety in my soul. To be sure, I have for such an end, according to the power given to me by God, made an attempt here and there and applied all diligence; but alas! how little has this calling been understood, even by those who might yet become fellow-students of that high and holy society of disciples <note>original: "Lehrjünger-Gesellschafft." A group of spiritual seekers or apprentices learning the ways of the internal life.</note> waiting <insert>in their inward sanctuary</insert> <term>inward sanctuary: "inwendigen Heiligthum," a central Pietist concept referring to the heart or soul as a temple where God dwells</term>; so that with great longsuffering <note>original: "Langmuth," meaning patient endurance or forbearance.</note> I have looked here and there with this intent, to see if the most holy wind <note>A biblical metaphor for the Holy Spirit (from John 3:8), suggesting a divine movement that inspires the soul.</note> might not blow upon one or another from within, so that at last a beginning might be made toward this great and spiritual assembly.

# Warning to the Priests of God.

...[un-]divided <note>The German text begins with "theilte," likely the end of "ungetheilte" (undivided), continuing the thought from the previous page.</note>, but instead should cling intimately and closely to the **One**, just as he was once won and brought to Him. For the priestly service of the Spirit is a very delicate and pure matter, which requires uncommonly qualified persons if **God** is to speak through them. For should any part of "selfhood" <term>Selbheit: the ego or self-centered nature that competes with divine will</term> attempt to mingle in, it would dampen the burning lamp of the Spirit and cause it to burn weakly and dimly. This is a warning for me and a friend, as well as for those who truly set themselves apart for this end: that they may build up a holy priesthood and tabernacle in which the **Holy Spirit** may reveal Himself and appear as a new spring to proclaim the Gospel. This Spirit, through His operation, will cast out the rotten mass of all filth born of selfhood—which might otherwise dampen and hinder the burning of the Holy Spirit’s coal of love.

29. Thereupon, I also remembered our Nazarene vow <note>original: "Nazarenischen Gelübts" — a reference to the biblical "Nazirite" vow of consecration and separation to God described in Numbers 6.</note>, wondering whether we had duly kept to it or not? ->Jesus help!<- <note>original: "Jesu juva!" — a traditional pious invocation often placed at the beginning of manuscripts or printed works.</note>

# The
## Publisher
### To
# THE READER.

One lives in the confident hope
that this small treatise—
as well as the preceding
one, of which this is a further
elaboration—will not give
anyone any cause for offense,
but rather shall serve for the
joy and comfort of the very
many people whom it might
reach, both within this and
among various other nations.
For it is rightly believed that all those
who confess that they need to be baptized
in and upon the faith of Jesus
must have a sufficient instruction
regarding what faith is from those
who have for a long time stood in the
practice and experience of the same.
Consequently, such individuals are undeniably
to be held as the most capable and
understanding to judge these matters,
as faith can never be learned
without a constant and tireless
dedication, nor reached in practice
through any lower degrees (even with
diligent perseverance), nor obtained

to those themselves who call themselves **Abraham's Children** <note>A biblical reference to those who claim religious status through heritage or tradition rather than active faith.</note>, to be a stumbling block and an offense; And because these two small treatises proceed more from experience and trial, we want to hope that they will be received with greater inclination—if not by the former, then at least by the latter. ## Extract of a Letter from the Author to a Friend, dated London, March 17, Old Style, 1696. <note>original: *st. vet.* (stilo vetere); referring to the Julian calendar, which was still in use in England at the time while most of Europe had adopted the Gregorian calendar.</note>

As for your question regarding **man's conscience** and the true or false accusers that arise within it / let this serve as instruction / that the conscience in man is twofold / namely **Natural** and **Supernatural**. The **Natural** stands under the legalistic **severity** and **sharpness** according to the dispensation and service of Mount Sinai <note>A reference to the Mosaic Law given to Moses on Mount Sinai, which the author views as a state of strict judgment and "letter" before the arrival of spiritual grace</note>; from which we are set free through the law of another conscience / which consists in a freedom released from those burdens. For there is no accusation / judgment or condemnation against those / who have the **Birth of Christ** formed or shaped within them; especially since such people do not actually bring themselves under guilt by their own will. For although movements [of the soul] may perhaps occur within them that incline in that direction / which resist the law of the Spirit of Life / yet all such things are not credited to the soul / and therefore no legal charge or accusation can be brought against them (by the enemy): so that such a thing (if it should happen) is a pure, false charge and accusation of the cunningly false accuser <note>A common mystical reference to the devil as the "Accuser of the Brethren" from the Book of Revelation</note> / who is quite ready and nimble to push and shove such heavy loads and impositions onto the soul and neck / which might strike down their **courage** and **faith** and sink them: for no greater hindrance could befall them / nor a heavier bolt be slid before the door / to prevent them from breaking through to God in the sanctuary / or

<summary>In this letter extract, the author distinguishes between the "Natural" conscience, which is bound by the strict laws of Mount Sinai, and the "Supernatural" conscience, which is freed through the inner "Birth of Christ." She argues that for the spiritual believer, feelings of guilt are often false accusations from the enemy meant to discourage the soul from entering God's presence.</summary>

### Postscript of the Author.

In that this book—concerning the nature, quality, and effect of those things known in **Divine Magic** <term>Divine Magic: In the 17th-century theosophical tradition, this refers to the "Magia Posthuma" or the spiritual power of the soul to act in harmony with God's will, distinct from sorcery or "black" magic.</term> and the representations <note>Likely referring to the mystical diagrams or "figures" often included in these works.</note> received and seen in many places at the front and back of these pages—is left behind, according to my intention, to the honor of God and Nature, and for the instruction and benefit of many souls: wherein one may not only see, or perhaps move the attention of those who mean well; we therefore hereby make known, that it is as little the honor of God to promote His own cause by having the cursed **Satan** worshipped hereby, or by [promoting] misery or curses—and it is just as far from God’s countenance—as this writing is from such shameful movements or forms. Rather, this text only touches upon their qualities <note>The author is explaining that discussing evil or "the fall" is necessary to explain spiritual qualities, but does not mean the book itself is "evil."</note> and the power found below, and of Grace in Nature.

This implies being saved from destruction or being pulled out of a state of sin.</note>—and all this, through Divine Mercy, happens to us in a well-preserved state.

May God, in Grace, grant that the same might bless us.

->Your Indebted Servant.<-
